role: Final frozen-cohort interface diagnostic before deciding whether a new scientific study is justified
question: Among J6B paths that reached the scorer, which overlapping residual, union-winding and charge-winding flags accompany failure, and what commit timing is recorded, without changing the unconditional estimand?
research_basis: Existing Lab 005 D4 projector/fusion interface and scorer; no new physical model or literature-derived method is introduced. The frozen D0 audit established that scored failures account for most of each proposal-triggered net count difference, but did not identify their overlapping flag patterns or timing.
competing_explanations: Terminal residual dominates scored failures, making a scorer/temporal-completion interface check more informative than more sampling.
Union or charge winding without terminal residual dominates, favoring a distinct spatial recovery/charge-action diagnostic.
Flags substantially overlap and timing differs across arms, so this observational audit cannot choose a mechanism; any intervention requires a separate contract.

scope.independent_unit: One original five-round matched history; 128 histories per stochastic cell, eight unconditional arms per history.
scope.paired_contrasts: All 14 online pairs from the immutable J6B paired analysis; offline is arm-level descriptive only.

diagnostic_matrix: For every stochastic cell and all eight arms, retain a full 4-bit mask histogram among scored rows plus failed-closed count. Preserve overlap: no priority-ordered or mutually exclusive attribution among physical, union, charge and terminal-residual flags.

For every cell and arm, record exact unique-commit-count, invocation-count and per-round physical-commit histograms within the three D0 outcome categories; validate unique_commit_count equals commit_rounds length and legal commit rounds.

For all 14 original online paired contrasts, count sparse 4-bit mask transitions only where both matched rows were scored, and separately count pairs with either failed-closed row. Reconcile scored-pair and abort-pair totals with D0's matched three-by-three outcome table.
integrity_gates: Verify all four frozen input hashes and D0 status; retain exactly 2176 rows, 272 histories, 16 stochastic arms and 14 paired contrasts. Every mask, outcome, timing and matched-pair histogram must close on the original complete histories; never drop failed-closed rows from the unconditional denominator.
stop_rule: On any hash, Boolean-score, timing or mass-balance mismatch, write no interpreted result and stop. Do not change the old score, trigger, sample or arm definitions and do not start a larger cohort.
claim_boundary: Post-hoc descriptive flag/timing audit only. Neither mask frequency nor timing association identifies a causal failure mechanism, conditional logical-error rate, schedule benefit, threshold or hardware-realistic fault tolerance.
